title: ReactBench-AD: Do Driving VLAs and World-Action Models React to Imminent Hazards in Their Path?
abstract: arXiv:2611.20011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. translated_title: ReactBench-AD：驾驶VLA模型与世界-动作模型能否对其路径中迫近的危险做出反应？
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）在自动驾驶领域兴起，有望对长尾场景实现强大的泛化能力。尽管这些模型在自动驾驶基准测试中取得了最先进的成果，但大多数现有基准以常规场景为主，因此无法检验这一承诺。为了测试一种对安全至关重要的长尾能力，我们提出了ReactBench-AD，这是一个衡量驾驶模型如何对出现在自车路径中的物体做出反应的基准。ReactBench-AD构建于真实的NAVSIM和PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles场景之上，在所有相机视角和历史帧中一致地合成横穿行人、站立行人或静止车辆。因此，每个编辑后的场景与其原始场景形成精确的像素级反事实配对，使我们能够分离插入物体对预测轨迹的因果影响。
tldr: 提出ReactBench-AD基准，通过像素级反事实场景编辑在真实驾驶数据中合成突现障碍物，用以评估驾驶VLA模型和世界-动作模型对自车路径中迫近危险的反应能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that uses pixel-level counterfactual scene editing to evaluate how driving VLAs and World-Action Models react to imminent hazards appearing in the ego vehicle's path.
